ideas.title: Uncovering the Extent of Child Care Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the scale and impact of child care fraud in Minnesota, including entities involved and the effect on federal funding
questions: What is the total amount of fraudulent claims?
How does this impact Minnesota's child care system?

ideas.insight: This story could reveal the depth of fraud in Minnesota's child care system and potentially expose a larger pattern of abuse.
